post.description:
Generate and persist a remediation plan using CP-SAT optimizer (I06–I10).

Body JSON:
  finding_ids: list[UUID]
  safety_contract_ids: list[UUID]
  candidate_template_ids: list[UUID]  (hint; ignored with synthetic stubs)
  max_change_cost: int                 (0 = unlimited)

get.description: Return ranked alternative feasible plans by relaxing cost budgets.

post.description:
Simulate a plan against safety contracts (DRAFT → SIMULATED).

Validates plan_sha256, asset ownership, and service contracts.
For unknown mandatory contracts → blocks autonomous execution.

Create a Change record (DRAFT state).

Operator creates change; requires a FEASIBLE plan, APPROVED approval,
and SAFE_IN_MODEL simulation with matching plan hashes.

Advance change state (e.g. APPROVED → EXECUTING → VERIFYING → VERIFIED).

Requires operator MFA. Validates plan hash at every transition.
Blocks execution if any mandatory safety contract is UNSUPPORTED.

Generate a cryptographically signed proof-of-hardening dossier.

Requires:
- change_id: completed change (state = VERIFIED)
- Auditor role with MFA

Produces:
- Canonical manifest linking: original findings, plan hash, approval,
  simulation, execution events, before/after evidence hashes, residual risk
- Ed25519 signature over the canonical manifest SHA-256
- Stored in audit_evidence + reports

Verify a proof manifest's Ed25519 signature and SHA-256 hash integrity.

Tampered manifests will fail signature verification.
Failed verifications can NEVER transition a change to VERIFIED (E19).
